places.name: North Platte River
places.note: Call heads south from it with the coffin, still stung by Clara's words.

places.name: Republican River
places.note: Crossed during Call's first week south of Clara's ranch.

places.name: Kansas
places.note: Call meets eight trail herds in a week; bosses give him wire to patch the buggy, but endless questions drive him west.

places.name: Rocky Mountains
places.note: Trappers Call meets are coming east from them.

places.name: Colorado
places.note: Call turns west into it to avoid the busy cattle trails.

places.name: Denver
places.note: Call wires Wilbarger's brother about his death; a crowd gathers at the coffin and an undertaker pesters him.

places.name: Purgatoire River
places.note: Camped here, Call is visited by Goodnight, who reports Blue Duck captured and due to hang at Santa Rosa.

places.name: Pueblo
places.note: Goodnight says he has business interests there.

places.name: Canadian River
places.note: Goodnight credits Gus with wiping out an outlaw gang there, though Blue Duck slipped away.

places.name: Raton Pass
places.note: Call takes the buggy over it down onto the New Mexico plain.

places.name: Sangre de Cristo Mountains
places.note: Snow still caps its peaks to the north as Call descends.

places.name: New Mexico
places.note: Call is struck by its vast open reach and later follows the Pecos south through it.

places.name: Santa Rosa
places.note: Crowds gather for the hanging; Blue Duck dives from the courthouse's third floor, dragging Deputy Decker to his death, and is strung up dead.
places.location_hint: New Mexico, on the Pecos side of the plains

places.name: Bosque Redondo
places.note: Blue Duck murdered two families there before capture; Call passes through following the Pecos.
places.location_hint: on the Pecos River in eastern New Mexico, near Fort Sumner

places.name: Llano Estacado
places.note: Blue Duck long terrorized it; in a drought year its grass is brown and shimmering with mirages as Call crosses.

places.name: Pecos River
places.note: Call follows it south despite Indian risk; its alkali water sickens him after the buggy wrecks in it.

places.name: Pecos ambush site
places.note: Call is shot from ambush, wrecks the buggy and coffin in the river, kills one attacker and rigs a travois from Gus's sign.
places.location_hint: on the Pecos River in west Texas, about a day's travel upstream (north) of Horsehead Crossing

places.name: Horsehead Crossing
places.note: Landmark a day downstream of where Call is ambushed.
places.location_hint: Pecos River crossing in west Texas

places.name: Colorado River (Texas)
places.note: After the mule gives out, the dun hauls the travois all the way to it; after that the danger eases.

places.name: San Saba River
places.note: Call doubts he can even reach it or the Colorado across the dry country.

places.name: Austin
places.note: Call figures the bullet must stay in him until he reaches it.

places.name: Gus's grave on the Guadalupe
places.note: Gus's chosen picnic spot; Call buries him with the old company sign as a marker and scratches his initials on it.
places.location_hint: small hill with live oaks and a pool above the Guadalupe River in the limestone hills; a ridge trail leads down toward San Antonio

places.name: Guadalupe River
places.note: Call's destination; he digs Gus's grave on a hill above it.

places.name: San Antonio
places.note: Settlers head for it; Call rides there seeking a doctor but skirts the town, unnerved by crowds.

places.name: Nueces River
places.note: Crossing it, Call recalls the snakes and the Irish boy who died there.

places.name: Lonesome Dove
places.note: Call returns in August to find Bolivar living in the ruined house and the Dry Bean burned, Wanz dying inside it.
places.location_hint: south Texas border town on the Rio Grande, in the chaparral south of the Nueces

places.name: Hat Creek
places.note: Call walks across its dry bed into the main street.
places.location_hint: runs past the Hat Creek outfit's barn at Lonesome Dove

places.name: Rio Grande
places.note: Bolivar's evening dinner bell rings out across it.

places.name: Mexico
places.note: Bolivar's return home went badly, so he walked back to Lonesome Dove.

places.name: Montana
places.note: Call says the rest of the outfit is there; he is too worn to ride back.

places.name: Texas
places.note: Call finally brings Gus home; he remembers first coming there as an orphaned boy in a wagon.

groups.label: Call
groups.hint: back at the old Hat Creek place, wounded, standing at the ashes of the Dry Bean

groups.label: Lonesome Dove residents
groups.hint: Bolivar living in the abandoned Hat Creek house
